$comment: Veo's own analysis of this match, captured 2026-09-19 directly from Veo's private API while authenticated in a browser. This is a BENCHMARK TO MATCH OR BEAT, not ground truth about football and NOT seed data. Never load it into the app as fixture data. It REPLACES the previous hand-derived file, whose second-half timestamps were wrong by up to 752 s because they were inferred from Veo's displayed match clock using guessed offsets.

supersedes.why: Derived video_s from match-clock strings with assumed offsets (+561 H1, +1080 H2) and an assumed 2400 s half. Measured reality: offsets 562 and 3674, halves 2317.0 and 2457.7. Home-goal error was 3 s / 752 s / 234 s against a +/-30 s tolerance, so a correct detector would have been scored as missing goals it found.
supersedes.lesson: Self-consistent arithmetic is not corroboration. The old file's 'all 13 attempts land inside the video' check passed while being badly wrong.

match.title: Arlington SA U16B ECNL (26-27) vs Skyline U16B ECNL

video.note: NO audio stream. Whistle-based foul detection is structurally impossible.

provenance.auth: Bearer token from the live web session; EPHEMERAL, never committed
provenance.note: The slug returns 403 on these endpoints; the match UUID is required.

time_base.$comment: MEASURED, not inferred. video_s = period_time_s + offset_s. Each period's offset is a single exact value across all its events.
time_base.warning: Do NOT reconstruct these from Veo's displayed match-clock strings. That is how the previous file went wrong. Use video_time_ms from the raw CSV.

coordinate_system.$comment: Decoded 2026-09-19 by fitting events with known geometry.
coordinate_system.x: length axis, normalized; goal lines at x=0 and x=1
coordinate_system.z: width axis, normalized; touchlines at z=0 and z=1

evidence.both_teams_use_both_ends: so coordinates are absolute, not flipped per attacking direction

to_metres.measured_offset: centre spot lands at (54.5, 34.4) m on a 105x68 model vs the ideal (52.5, 34.0) - a ~2 m systematic bias in Veo's own calibration. Recorded, not corrected.
to_metres.values_are_unclamped: z ranges -0.029..1.026, so treat as a model projection with noise

events.note_pass: Veo's UI shows a 15th type, Pass (203 own / 283 opponent), which this endpoint does NOT expose. Per-event Pass scoring is therefore impossible; only an aggregate count can be compared.

veo_published_stats.$comment: The 13 rows of Veo's stats table, own/opponent.

structural_identities.$comment: Free self-consistency checks. Run these on OUR output first - they fail faster and cheaper than a scored comparison.
structural_identities.fouls_mirror_freekicks: Foul 8/7 vs FreeKick 7/8 - Veo emits a paired Foul(offender)+FreeKick(beneficiary). ONE detector, not two.
structural_identities.possession_is_control_time: 14+22=36 min of control out of ~79 min of play; 14/36=38.9% ~ the published 38%. Control is only ~46% of playing time. Any model attributing 70 min of control is wrong by construction.

scoring_protocol.$comment: How to use this file. Report losses as loudly as wins.
scoring_protocol.primary: Per-type Hungarian one-to-one matching on |dt|, capped at that type's match_tolerance_s, requiring team match. Score against video_s only.
headline_metrics: macro_F1 over ATTEMPTED types (each type weighted equally)
parity_count: integer number of types at F1 >= 0.5, out of 14
rules: Score against video_s derived from video_time_ms. Never against a match-clock string.

Print the expected-by-chance baseline beside every recall figure. A detector emitting n candidates over duration D hits a given event by luck with probability 1-(1-2*tol/D)^n; for interception (n=89, tol=2s) that is ~7.5%.
Report precision AND recall. Recall alone is how noise looks like success.
Report n on every row. Flag n<10 as low-n and report counts, not percentages.
Types not attempted are status 'not_attempted', EXCLUDED from macro-F1 but counted in two separate coverage figures: type coverage and event-mass coverage.
A type that IS attempted and scores 0 stays in the macro average. The attempted-set is declared in a manifest committed BEFORE the run; the harness enforces this, not discipline.
Period 1 is the dev set, period 2 is held out. Report both side by side so leakage shows up as a gap.
Report team-agnostic score alongside team-conditioned, to separate detection error from attribution error.
Jersey accuracy is computed on true positives only.
The 13 stat rows are scored as signed relative error; a rendered em-dash means NOT PRODUCED and is explicitly not an error of 0.
Penalty is 0/0. 'Matching' it proves nothing - report 'no penalty-spot restart found'.
Beating Veo means finding events it missed, which this file cannot demonstrate. Claim it only with a timestamp a human confirmed on the video.
